title: New Local AI Model Inkling 2 Mini Arrives

opening.say: Good morning, this is Mono Radio. It's Sunday morning, November twenty-second.
opening.show: Good morning, this is Mono Radio. It's Sunday morning, November 22.

opening.say: Today we have five stories on AI and three D printing.
opening.show: Today we have five stories on AI and 3D printing.

closing.say: Our pick today is the looped model Inkling two Mini. We're curious how far it can go running locally.
closing.show: Our pick today is the looped model Inkling 2 Mini. We're curious how far it can go locally.

news.label: Inkling 2 Mini released
details: It's an open-weight model with 26.4 billion total parameters and 3.4 billion active at a time.
The middle layers of the Transformer are run three times for each token.
It runs with Ollama on Macs with 32GB or more, and also supports inference with vLLM and llama.cpp-based tools.

lines.say: First up, Inkling two Mini, released by Thinking Machines Lab.
lines.show: First up, Inkling 2 Mini, released by Thinking Machines Lab.

lines.say: It loops through its middle layers three times, and needs about twenty gigabytes of memory.
lines.show: It loops through its middle layers three times and needs about 20GB of memory.

lines.say: It's also getting high marks for coding performance.
lines.show: It's also getting high marks for coding performance.

link.title: Introducing Inkling 2 Mini
link.description: Inkling 2 Mini is an open-weights model small enough to run on your laptop. It loops its middle layers to reason more per token and reach answers in fewer tokens.

news.label: Gemini on Mac controls the screen
points: US English version only for now
details: It clicks and types in a separate window, so you can keep working while checking its progress.
The official demo shows a butterfly being modeled and rigged in Blender.
It requires conditions such as a Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 15 or later.

lines.say: Next, Google's Gemini can now operate your Mac's screen.
lines.show: Next, Google's Gemini can now operate your Mac's screen.

lines.say: A demo showed it modeling a butterfly in Blender, but for now it's only available in US English.
lines.show: A demo showed it modeling a butterfly in Blender, but for now it's US English only.

link.title: Let Gemini tackle repetitive chores on your Mac
link.description: The Gemini app for Mac now has computer use to help you with repetitive tasks.

news.label: Eight-head 3D printer MC8
points: Head swap in about 4 seconds, claimed
details: Axiloop showed off the MC8 with eight independent heads, plus the enclosed MC8 Pro.
The maker claims a preheated head can be swapped in about four seconds.
It's currently at the crowdfunding stage, with shipping planned for the first quarter of 2027.

lines.say: Now to three D printing, with the MC eight from Axiloop.
lines.show: Now to 3D printing, with the MC8 from Axiloop.

lines.say: It has eight heads, and swapping them takes a claimed four seconds or so.
lines.show: It has eight heads, and swapping takes a claimed four seconds or so.

lines.say: Shipping is planned for the first quarter of twenty twenty-seven.
lines.show: Shipping is planned for the first quarter of 2027.

link.title: Axiloop launches the MC8 and MC8 Pro, with eight toolheads and four-second tool changes - 3Dnatives
link.description: The MC8 and its enclosed version, the MC8 Pro, are desktop FDM 3D printers with eight independent toolheads, one for each color or material.

news.label: Joint study on physical AI platform
details: They agreed to jointly study a physical AI development platform for inspecting and maintaining power facilities.
The idea is to put AI trained in simulation onto real machines, then feed field data back into retraining.
At this stage it's a plan to build the platform, not a finished product.

lines.say: Now a story from Japan. J-Power, Hitachi and Macnica will jointly study a physical AI platform.
lines.show: Now a story from Japan. J-Power, Hitachi and Macnica will study a physical AI platform.

lines.say: It's still at the planning stage, starting with a possible trial using power line inspection drones.
lines.show: It's still at the planning stage, starting with a possible power line drone trial.

news.label: Gemini analyzes fire radio
points: Watch Duty built it with Google
details: Using over twenty thousand hours of past recordings, it transcribes noisy VHF radio speech to detect signs of fire.
Google says the word error rate on degraded radio audio improved by this much.

lines.say: Last up, Google used Gemini to analyze noisy fire department radio.
lines.show: Last up, Google used Gemini to analyze noisy fire department radio.

lines.say: The word error rate improved from thirty-eight percent to about twenty-two percent.
lines.show: The word error rate improved from 38% to about 22%.

lines.say: Some fire reports were detected within thirty seconds.
lines.show: Some fire reports were detected within 30 seconds.

link.title: How Watch Duty is using Gemini to get wildfire alerts out faster
link.description: Watch Duty uses Gemini to turn noisy fire radio into text, spotting wildfire dispatches in under 30 seconds so alerts go out faster.
